fullContent:
Dashamoola Kashayam 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali kasaroga adhikara 13 – 15. 
 Introduction 
 Dashamoola Kashayam is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to contain mixture of effective herbs. Dashamoola is a Sanskrit word which means ‘ten roots’. This formulation is in liquid form. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Patala – Stereospermum suaveolens 
 Shyonaka – Oroxylum indicum 
 Gambhari – Gmelina arborea 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Prishnaparni – Uraria picta 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Bilva – Aegle marmelos 
 Shalaparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Agnimantha – Premna mucronata 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the herbs in equal quantity and put in a pot. 
 Add the water in that pot and boil the water. 
 Boil till water level is reduced up to its one fourth level. 
 After boiling, filter the water and your decoction is prepared. 
 
 Dose 
 Take 12 to 24 grams, two times a day, before meals, with equal quantity of water. 
 Indications 
 
 Fever 
 Cough 
 Pain in flanks 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
